content.text: In the discussion channel, a user inquired about something that was confirmed to be unofficial by D0CT0R. A suspicious recruitment message was posted by user Thehuuhs advertising job openings for the Shape3 ecosystem, claiming to seek Community Managers at 20-40 dollars per hour and Growth and Marketing Managers at 40-140 dollars per hour, with remote work and upfront payment. This same recruitment message was also cross-posted in the coders channel along with an attached image, suggesting coordinated spam activity across multiple channels.

In the coders channel, PnL Labs announced the release of a new plugin for Solana traders called plugin-pnllabs. The plugin is designed to allow agents to verify information before acting, including wallet trust based on realized on-chain profit and loss data, token safety checks, real trade cost analysis, and funding forensics. The team noted they audited 30 tracked smart money wallets and found that roughly half were actually losing money. The plugin is available via npm install at no cost for a free tier with no API key required, and uses a pay-per-call model through x402 after the free tier. The developer welcomed community feedback.
